scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:css
scripts.dev: npx wrangler pages dev dist --d1 DB=dragon-hunt-leaderboard
scripts.db:migrate:local: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply dragon-hunt-leaderboard --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply dragon-hunt-leaderboard --remote
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx wrangler pages deploy dist
